title: Fur Coat
description: Upon pickup, mark 7 random combats. Enemies in those rooms have 1 HP.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic marks 7 random combat or elite rooms on the act where it is obtained. When entering a marked combat, all enemies in that room have their HP set to 1. If enemies are added to combat after combat starts in a marked room, their HP is also set to 1. Marked rooms remain active only for the current act.
